notes.title: AstroMole demo update
notes.content:
[b]Hello Brave Travellers![/b]

The AstroMole demo just got better! A new level has been added, [b]Prehistoric Sands[/b]!

There are even more Treasures to find in these Dino filled Planets, as well as plenty of enemies and allies!

Butt heads with these guys:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/05b2a8c377c5b78f23263c261169dada03a97bcd.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/05b2a8c377c5b78f23263c261169dada03a97bcd.gif[/img][/url]

Escape the pursuit of these mean Dinos:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/aae701bedce0fb8331c99e93f1feb10d78d9827b.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/aae701bedce0fb8331c99e93f1feb10d78d9827b.gif[/img][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/f1fc5c5a9b04f3ec0bef2f010f7b4bc17b36d6a1.gif[/img]

Watch out for the Steggy's plates too:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/7cd1a3982517c24cf7d475081f0a5ccce5933c2a.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/7cd1a3982517c24cf7d475081f0a5ccce5933c2a.gif[/img][/url]

It's not just the Dinos that you'll have to look out for. The environment is dangerous too!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/8de2b86029f954f32039104ff3af60bd5527ea24.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/8de2b86029f954f32039104ff3af60bd5527ea24.gif[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/0202e2f602acd676fcfe94f5c92eea65003a5ce4.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/0202e2f602acd676fcfe94f5c92eea65003a5ce4.gif[/img][/url]

Luckily, there are some friendly Dinos that have evolved brains. They'll be happy to help as long as their social status remains intact!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/35ed38d0348c3d6ec20182c428f22d2451038171.png[/img]

Hope you enjoy the demo so far!

notes.title: The creatures of AstroMole
notes.content:
[b]Hello Brave Travellers![/b]

I've been working hard throughout April to get some interesting creatures in the game and thought you might like to hear about some of them. I'll give you some tips to deal with them too!

[u][b]UFO Bandits[/b][/u]
These UnFriendly Objects tend to group up together to ambush any lifeforms unfortunate enough to cross paths. You'll encounter two types of UFO Bandit when flying through space:

[b]Shotty[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/610f67d9b2e0e9a5b93513d7039f57570c95e008.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/610f67d9b2e0e9a5b93513d7039f57570c95e008.gif[/img][/url]

These guys will charge their energy beam and fire at you periodically. They need to time to recharge between shots, so striking with your drill attack during this opening is the best way to take them down.

[b]Chasey[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/fc620bf8bfd9e463b4e769606594abf7f63358db.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/fc620bf8bfd9e463b4e769606594abf7f63358db.gif[/img][/url]

These dastardly devices will chase you relentlessly through space once they've spotted you. Use you advantage in speed to make enough of a gap between you and launch a drill attack.

[u][b]ShellHogs[/b][/u]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/56bd7858e653ecf0ba38ddcfbcc07a8fef57fe8d.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/56bd7858e653ecf0ba38ddcfbcc07a8fef57fe8d.gif[/img][/url]

They may look friendly, but they're prickly in both personality and touch! They patrol planets endlessly, confident of the protection their needle covered shells afford them. 

Good thing they've never dealt with a Mole before! Your drill attacks won't work, but striking them in their vulnerable under-bellies from underground will!

[u][b]Fanatics[/b][/u]
They say these cultist groups worship a forest god in their own "unique" way. By unique, they mean protecting the forest from any creatures they don't recognise by attacking on sight! There are two types, often seen together:

[b]Acolytes[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/5c4c3d750dd97346b13bd0e27d36c37c9e1f3e76.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/5c4c3d750dd97346b13bd0e27d36c37c9e1f3e76.gif[/img][/url]

The smaller ones are simple creatures. They see a target, they start charging! Use your jetpack to get the upper hand and drill attack them from the air!

[b]Shamans[/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/a458267547e2e85d852a4d4eed33f4d9d5b103db.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/a458267547e2e85d852a4d4eed33f4d9d5b103db.gif[/img][/url]

These bearded weirdos have mastered some form of sorcery by drawing power from the forest. They'll hurl their incantations at you periodically, taking breaks in between to prepare for another sling. Use this opening to introduce them to your drill attack!

[u][b]Lizaral[/b][/u]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/c07968648fa0ccd82238b78f940594b7d2dc4b92.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/c07968648fa0ccd82238b78f940594b7d2dc4b92.gif[/img][/url]

Tales have been told of Lizards made of pure mineral. Other tales have been told about how quickly they scamper off at the slightest hint of danger!

If you should you be lucky enough to not only encounter one, but also land an attack on one? They say you'll be awarded handsomely with riches...

[b]Part 2 sneaky peeky: [i]E X P L O S I O N S[/i][/b]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/cf2b20b83e555c34c7baa73ce22e63019d464702.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/cf2b20b83e555c34c7baa73ce22e63019d464702.gif[/img][/url]


[b]That's all for now! See you next time![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/42446b0b40232f10787a625bf71c72a1988bccb2.png[/img]

notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello Brave Travellers![/b]

Just a quick update to say that work is progressing smoothly on the demo! The timeline has changed too so here's a summary of what expect over the next few months:

[list]
[*] [b]June 2024 - First demo release:[/b] the demo will contain one level that has one biome, with plenty of treasures to find and a variety of enemies to beat.
[*] [b]July-August 2024 - Final demo release:[/b] This demo will contain two levels with a biome each with even more treasure and enemies!
[*] [b]September 2024 - Full game release[/b]
[/list]
Look forward to more updates in the future! Follow my socials to stay updated [url=https://linktr.ee/BraveTravellerGames]HERE[/url]
